description: A digital nomad is moving from the US to Portugal. They face a conflict between US 'taxation by citizenship' and Portugal's NHR tax scheme requirements. They need to plan their physical presence days to avoid double taxation.

user_profile.context: Planning the move to optimize tax and lifestyle

fact_sheet.fact: The client's full legal name is Alexander 'Alex' Vance, a citizen of the United States of America, born on May 14, 1984.
Alex Vance retained 'Global Nomad Tax Solutions' on November 10, 2023, under client ID AV-2023-PTUS.
The lead tax advisor assigned to Alex Vance's case is Sofia Mendes, whose direct contact is sofia.mendes@gntax.com.
To qualify for the US Foreign Earned Income Exclusion (FEIE) in 2024, Alex Vance must be physically present in a foreign country for at least 330 full days during a consecutive 12-month period.

To establish tax residency in Portugal for 2024, Alex Vance must remain in the country for more than 183 days, consecutively or non-consecutively, within a 12-month period beginning or ending in that year.

Under Portugal's Non-Habitual Resident (NHR) scheme, Alex Vance's qualifying foreign-sourced income is exempt from Portuguese tax, and Portuguese-sourced income from high-value-added activities is taxed at a flat rate of 20%.
Alex Vance obtained his Portuguese Tax Identification Number (NIF), 298 456 712, on January 5, 2024, through his fiscal representative, 'Lisbon Fiscal Services'.
Alex Vance's first entry into Portugal in 2024 was on January 15, 2024, via flight TP214 from Newark (EWR) to Lisbon (LIS).
Alex Vance must register for NHR status with the Portuguese Tax and Customs Authority (Autoridade Tributária e Aduaneira) via the Portal das Finanças by March 31, 2025.
For the period January 15, 2024, to December 31, 2024, Alex Vance has planned a maximum of 35 days outside of Portugal to comply with the 183-day rule.
Alex Vance must not spend more than 35 days in the US during 2024 to avoid triggering the Substantial Presence Test, which would make him a US tax resident.
Alex Vance signed a 24-month lease for an apartment at Rua dos Anjos, 1170-015, Lisbon, 3rd Floor, with a monthly rent of €2,100, starting February 1, 2024.
Alex Vance opened a personal bank account with 'Banco Atlântico' on January 18, 2024, with account number PT50 0099 0001 1234 5678 9012 3.
Alex Vance's primary US client is 'QuantumLeap Advisory LLC', which pays him a retainer of $25,000 USD per month.
On February 5, 2024, Alex Vance established a Portuguese sole proprietorship ('Unipessoal Lda.') named 'Vance Consultoria Unipessoal Lda.' with company registration number 517 987 654.
All income from 'QuantumLeap Advisory LLC' is invoiced by and paid directly to 'Vance Consultoria Unipessoal Lda.'s' business account at Banco Atlântico.
A scheduled quarterly tax planning call between Alex Vance and Sofia Mendes is set for April 10, 2024, at 15:00 Lisbon time via Zoom link https://gntax.zoom.us/j/89101112.
Alex Vance uses the 'Nomad Tracker Pro' mobile app (version 3.1) to log his physical presence days, with automated alerts for approaching the 35-day US limit and 183-day Portugal requirement.
Alex Vance applied for his Certificate of Registration for EU Citizen (CRUE) at the Lisbon City Council office on February 20, 2024.
For his 2024 US tax return (Form 1040), Alex Vance will file Form 2555 to claim the Foreign Earned Income Exclusion.
The income earned through 'Vance Consultoria Unipessoal Lda.' is considered Portuguese-sourced and will be taxed at the NHR flat rate of 20% after business deductions.
Alex Vance maintains a US bank account at 'Keystone National Bank' (Acct: ...7890) solely for paying US-based expenses and receiving US-sourced passive income, totaling less than $5,000 annually.
Alex Vance has a planned business trip to New York from June 3, 2024, to June 10, 2024, which will count as 8 days of US presence.
The electricity contract for his Lisbon apartment is with 'EnergiaLuz SA' under contract number EL-8845-2024, providing proof of address.
Alex Vance registered with the Portuguese Social Security (Segurança Social) on March 1, 2024, and was assigned NISS number 1 8765 4321 098.
As a self-employed individual ('trabalhador independente'), Alex Vance's monthly social security contribution is calculated as 21.4% of his declared income, with a 12-month initial exemption.
The total fee for 'Global Nomad Tax Solutions' for the 2024 tax year is a fixed rate of €7,500, payable in two installments.
The deadline for filing the 2024 Portuguese IRS (Modelo 3) tax return is June 30, 2025.
The deadline for filing the 2024 US tax return for an expatriate like Alex Vance is automatically extended to June 15, 2025, with a further extension available to October 15, 2025.
Alex Vance registered for the Portuguese National Health Service (SNS) and received his user number (número de utente) 210987654 on March 5, 2024.
The rental contract for Rua dos Anjos, 1170-015, is registered with the tax authority under contract number 2024/FIN-LOC-19842, a requirement for proving residency.
Alex Vance is required to file a Report of Foreign Bank and Financial Accounts (FBAR) with FinCEN by April 15, 2025, as his aggregate foreign account balances exceed $10,000.
The registered address for 'Vance Consultoria Unipessoal Lda.' is Alex Vance's residential address: Rua dos Anjos, 1170-015, Lisbon.
An email from Sofia Mendes dated March 15, 2024, confirmed that Alex's NHR application (Process #PTAX-24-98712) was successfully submitted online.
The tax strategy document (Ref: 'AV-Strategy-2024-v3') specifies that any day spent partly in the US counts as a full day for the Substantial Presence Test calculation.
